posts.title: Two more bosses
posts.body:
There is now a boss at the end of Season 2 and Season 3 as well.

Ironpaw is a mech standing on a bridge. It is armoured, so hosing it does nothing at all until its chest swings open. Wait for that, then hit the glowing core, and get out of the way when it stomps.

Emberwing is a dragon over a castle. You can only hurt it while it is perched. It flies off to another perch every few seconds and burns a stretch of wall on the way past, so hit it hard while it is down.

The Nuke Splash is fixed. It was putting out the whole level, which was not the idea. It now clears only the one wall your laser is on, and you can drop it straight on a boss for half its health. It costs 150 jits now.

Good luck.

posts.title: There is a monster in level 11
posts.body:
Level 11 of Season 1 is a boss fight.

It is called The Blaze. It is a monster made of fire, built like a gorilla, and it is standing in the middle of an oil refinery. The bar across the top of the screen is its health.

Put the creature out first, not the tanks. While you are working on it, watch its arm: when it winds back it is about to throw a ball of fire at the refinery behind it, and whatever it hits will be burning when you turn round. It takes about twenty seconds of holding the jet on it.

When it goes down the refinery erupts and three workers appear at once. That part decides your third star.

You will find it at the bottom of the Season 1 map, the big red one. It unlocks when you have cleared level 10.

There is also a new Gadgets button under Levels. You pick one and it comes with you into every level, and it works once per level.

Splash Bomb: tap once to aim and a ring shows you exactly where it will land, tap again to throw. It bursts across five fires at once. Thrown into the monster's chest it takes off nearly a third of its health.

Triple Head: ten seconds of three jets, and the rule about having to drop the pressure for low fires stops applying.

Rescue Net: thirty seconds where the next two people who would fall get caught instead.

Cold Snap: eight seconds where every fire stops growing and stops spreading. For when it is all getting away from you.

Sprinkler: aim at a fire the way you would hose it, tap, and it puts that one out on its own for twenty seconds while you deal with everything else.

Go and fight it.

posts.title: The shop is open
posts.body:
There are three new buttons at the very bottom of the screen now.

The bell is announcements, so that is where you are reading this. The podium is the leaderboard. The purple tag is the shop. There are no words under them, so hold one down for a second and it will tell you what it is. Play and Levels have not moved.

The shop is the big one. 36 things to buy, split into nozzles, hoses and water colours. Some of them are serious and some of them are not: there is a dragon, a rubber duck, an old boot and a fish head. The hoses come striped now too, including a candy cane, a tiger, a snake and a full rainbow. The water can be lemonade, slime, lava, liquid gold or a few others.

You pay for all of it in jits, the purple coins. Jits come from stars and nothing else. One star is 2 jits, two stars is 4, and three stars is 7. You only get the third star when every single person and pet gets out alive, which is why it is worth going back to a level you have already beaten. Clearing a level again pays again.

There are 30 levels now across three seasons. Season 2 has been rebuilt from scratch: you are putting out fires in ordinary houses from that country, with the famous landmark lit up on the skyline behind you. Big Ben behind a London terrace, the Eiffel Tower behind a Paris apartment block, and so on. Season 3 is ten new places with something worth looking at in each one.

Go and spend your jits.

posts.title: Big update
posts.body:
Ten different places to fight fires in now. One of them is an airport - look up and you'll see planes going over with their lights blinking.

There's smoke drifting through the air now too, and people, kids and pets in the windows to rescue before their time runs out.

Shop coming really soon.

posts.title: Announcements are here
posts.body:
You can now read messages from me right inside the game.

This update also adds profiles, five different places to fight fires in, people and pets to rescue, and fires that go out quicker.

More coming soon.
